key.name: wifi-interface
key.summary: WiFi interface used to host the hotspot
key.description: Empty means auto-detect the first WiFi device.

key.name: internet-interface
key.description: Empty/same as the WiFi interface = classic single-card "AP + client at once" mode. 'none' disables internet sharing. Another interface (e.g. eth0) shares that instead.

key.name: password
key.description: WPA/WPA2 passphrase (8-63 chars), or 64 hex-digit raw PSK if psk-mode is enabled.

key.name: psk-mode
key.summary: Treat password as a raw 64-hex-digit PSK (create_ap --psk)

key.name: wpa-version
key.description: '1', '2', or '1+2' — passed straight through to create_ap's -w option.

key.name: band
key.description: '2.4' or '5' — passed straight through to create_ap's --freq-band.

key.name: no-virt
key.description: Leave this off to keep hosting the hotspot AND staying connected as a WiFi client on the same card at the same time.

key.name: autostart
key.summary: Turn hotspot on automatically at login
